name: qBittorrent API
description: Speaks qBittorrent's Web API (v2), so Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, autobrr, cross-seed and other qBittorrent clients work with apitorrent unchanged. Point them at /api/v1/plugins/qbittorrent-api as the URL base (or at a --plugin-listen port), sign in with any username and an apitorrent API token as the password. Categories are labels.
author: apitorrent

downloadHosts.title: Hosts .torrent links may be fetched from, when a client adds by URL (URL or host, such as prowlarr.lan:9696 or http://192.168.1.5:9696)

categorySavePaths.title: Save torrents in their category's folder when the client names no folder
